definitions: A Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Eiichiro Oda.
A media franchise based on the manga series, including anime, films, video games, and merchandise.
A fictional pirate crew led by Monkey D. Luffy in the One Piece series.
examples: One Piece is one of the best-selling manga series of all time.
The One Piece anime has been running for over two decades.
Many fans cosplay as characters from One Piece.
